comment: The manual documents three distortion circuits (Rodent, Cylinder, Blur) and three tone circuits (Crem, Diez, Puff); the installed 2.0.16 build has six and four: RODENT, CYLINDER, BLUR, BLUR2, BITE, FEVER and CREM, DIEZ, PUFF, HIGH. No source says what the GAIN setting does, so its two lines say only that it is stepped and shown on the screen. Parameters 6, 7 and 8 hold the three current settings and have positions at the lower edge of the screen; parameters 9, 10 and 11 are the three buttons under it, confirmed against the rendered panel.
